**Failure mode:** Platform / infra failure

**Where it went wrong:** Transcript [2], before any Agent turn. The sandbox never started, so the AOP never ran. Step 1 (Snowflake query) and Step 2 (Slack post) were never reached.

**Evidence:**
> "ERROR: sandbox failed to start: container image pull timed out after 120s (attempt 3/3)."

The other three Runs of this Agent failed with the same error before any Agent turn, so the failure is recurring and independent of the case data.

**Fix:** None in your artifacts. The AOP, Setup, and Connections are not implicated. The AOP's two steps (Snowflake query, Slack post) never executed, so nothing in them caused this. I also can't see anything in the Build that would prevent a container image pull from timing out, so editing the AOP or Connections would not help.

**What I ruled out:**
- AOP ambiguity or missing branches: the Agent never got a turn.
- Connection failure: no Connection call was attempted. Snowflake and Slack were never reached.
- Missing data: the failure happens before any input is read.

**Next step:** This needs to go to Duvo. The image pull is timing out on the platform side, and it repeats across Runs and days. If a support-escalation tool is available in your session (Duvo's in-product chat), I can draft an escalation with this diagnosis for you to review and send. I have not sent anything. If no such tool is available, raise it with Duvo support from the web app and include:
- Run IDs: run_p01 (and the three earlier failed Runs, if you have their IDs)
- Build ID: bld_p01
- Exact error: "sandbox failed to start: container image pull timed out after 120s (attempt 3/3)"
- Ruled out: AOP, Setup, Connections (Snowflake, Slack), and case data
